svg.title: Split illustration contrasting two developers — one stuck working slowly without AI, one moving fast while using an AI tool — illustrating that developers who leverage AI well are the ones who get ahead
svg.desc: Left half shows a developer slumped at a desk surrounded by scattered papers and a single dim monitor full of red error text, looking exhausted. Right half shows a developer sitting upright and confident with two monitors, one with code and one with a glowing green AI assistant panel, with a small upward progress arrow above their desk.
